## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

X332 in eight fascicles is [廣莫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E8%8E%AB)'s late-Míng comparative-collation (*cāndìng* 參訂) commentary on *[Léngqiéābáduōluó bǎo jīng 楞伽阿跋多羅寶經](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327)* (T670). The genre is *cāndìng* — collating earlier annotations and emending the textual corruption — combined with *shū* — a doctrinal commentary. The work is one of the late-Míng monastic productions on the *Laṅkāvatāra*, contemporary with [X326](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343) / [X328](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345) / [X329](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346) / [X330](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0347) / [X331](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348).

**Abstract**

[廣莫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E8%8E%AB) (DILA Authority A001663) is otherwise primarily known as a Vinaya specialist — author of the *Sìfēn jièběn yuánqǐ shìyì* ([KR6k0148](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0148)). The *Léngqié cāndìng shū* is therefore one of the few non-Vinaya works in the [廣莫](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%BB%A3%E8%8E%AB) corpus, and gives a different cross-section of his productive activity. Date bracket conservatively follows the late-Míng span (1580–1644); doctrinal vocabulary is consistent with a Wànlì–Chóngzhēn date.

Related canonical texts: parent sūtra [KR6i0327](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0327) (楞伽阿跋多羅寶經 / T670); contemporaneous late-Míng commentaries [KR6i0343](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0343), [KR6i0345](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0345), [KR6i0346](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0346), [KR6i0347](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0347), [KR6i0348](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6i/KR6i0348).
